name: Wrist Break
description: Easy wrist circles for hands that have been typing or drawing.

steps.title: Arms out in front
steps.text: Hold your arms in front of you with your hands relaxed.

steps.title: Circle gently
steps.text: Draw slow circles with your wrists, five one way and five the other.

steps.title: Bend and stretch
steps.text: Gently bend your hands up, then down, without pushing at the end of the movement.

steps.title: Shake it out
steps.text: Give your hands a loose, floppy little shake. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
